 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Superstar guard Luka Dončić was busy during the Los Angeles Lakers' opening night win over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.
 But the most viral moment of Dončić's night came after the game ended, when he was interviewed by ESPN's Malika Andrews .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement These two were all smiles and joking together throughout the interview, and an edited clip of the interview has amassed over six million views on X since it was posted on Wednesday night.
 Luka Doncic #77 of the Los Angeles Lakers talks with Malika Andrews after a game against the Golden State Warriors at Crypto.Com Arena in Los Angeles on Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026. NBAE via Getty Images
 Andrews appears to be proud of how the interview played out. On Thursday morning, she posted a clip of her conversation with Dončić to her Instagram story, where she asked him whether him saying, "This is the start of something new" was a reference to the iconic "High School Musical" song .
 "A little bit, for sure," Dončić, who is a known "High School Musical" fan, responded.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Andrews, who is married to fellow ESPN writer Dave McMenamin, is one of the league's most respected journalists, and has already cultivated a solid relationship with the Lakers superstar.
 Malika Andrews' Instagram story post of her interview with Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic. (Instagram/@malika_andrews).
 Malika Andrews attends the Neiman Marcus 2026 Fantasy Gifts & Holiday launch celebration at Neiman Marcus on Tuesday, Oct. 20, 2026, in Beverly Hills, Calif. Getty Images for Neiman Marcus
 Luka Doncic #77 of the Los Angeles Lakers talks with Malika Andrews after a game against the Golden State Warriors at Crypto.Com Arena in Los Angeles on Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026. NBAE via Getty Images
 Lakers fans are definitely feeling like this is a new era for their team with LeBron James no longer around.
 And it got off to a great start for Dončić and his teammates on Wednesday.
